highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.159.0 update improves glyph rendering, image-filter caching and Vulkan allocation failure handling.
highlights_body: These Skia m159 corrections leave managed APIs and the native ABI unchanged.

bullets.lead: Match image-filter cache equality to hashing
bullets.detail: Cache keys use bytewise equality, consistently distinguishing signed zero and matrix type metadata regardless of runtime subnormal handling. This aligns lookups, LRU eviction and purge behavior with the existing hash.

Mask-filtered text rasterizes the reloaded glyph rather than stale outline state when font-scaler loads differ. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and clipped embossed masks use full plane strides while overlapping SDF data is preserved.

bullets.lead: Avoid an Imagination Vulkan driver failure
bullets.detail: When descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination drivers, Skia abandons the affected pool rather than destroying it, avoiding a driver failure. The workaround is limited to that vendor and those allocation errors.
